WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb,
        AVG(CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE <> 0 THEN `T-BIL` / CRE END) AS average_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
    status_averages.CENTROMEA,
    status_averages.average_hgb,
    status_averages.average_ratio,
    status_averages.average_ratio / overall.overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_relative_to_overall_mean
FROM status_averages
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;
